title: Preparing a Property for Real Estate Photos and Video
h1: Preparing a property for real estate photos and video
description: How to prepare a property and brief for real estate photography, video, drone shots, virtual tours and floor plans, plus editing, delivery and usage rights.
intro: Listing photos and videos are often the first impression a buyer or renter has of a property. Professional photographers and videographers can make a huge difference, but the property itself must be ready, and the brief must say exactly which shots and formats you need. Many shoots fall short because rooms were cluttered, the weather was wrong or nobody asked for vertical video. This article explains how to prepare both the property and the brief.

faq.q: How long does a property shoot take?
faq.a: Often one to a few hours, depending on size and whether video and drone shots are included.
